display_name: Source to Pay - Invoice Exception Handling
process_step: Accounts payable > Three-way match > Exception resolution
description: A supplier invoice fails the three-way match against purchase order and goods receipt. The workflow decides whether to release payment, hold it, or send the exception to the buyer or budget owner.

price_variance.label: Price variance
price_variance.on_valid: Release for payment: variance within tolerance
price_variance.on_invalid: Hold: request credit note for price above PO
price_variance.policy_query: price variance tolerance purchase order unit price credit note

quantity_variance.label: Quantity variance
quantity_variance.on_valid: Release for payment: goods receipt matches invoice
quantity_variance.on_invalid: Hold: pay received quantity only, request debit note
quantity_variance.policy_query: quantity variance goods receipt grn partial delivery debit note

missing_po.label: Missing purchase order
missing_po.on_invalid: Reject under no-PO-no-pay and notify budget owner
missing_po.policy_query: no po no pay retrospective purchase order budget owner approval

duplicate_invoice.label: Possible duplicate
duplicate_invoice.on_valid: Release: duplicate check clear, distinct invoice
duplicate_invoice.on_invalid: Reject as duplicate and notify supplier
duplicate_invoice.policy_query: duplicate invoice check resubmitted reject notify supplier

tax_mismatch.label: Tax mismatch
tax_mismatch.on_valid: Release: tax code matches vendor and item master
tax_mismatch.policy_query: tax code mismatch gst vat hsn corrected tax invoice

value_model._note: ASSUMPTIONS for illustration. Replace with the client's measured baseline before building a business case.
